en.sayed-ali-raza: When I am dead hard circumstances and distressing events would befall you,
many persons in the position of asking question would remain silent with cast down eye, while those in the position of replying would lose courage.
This would be at a time when wars would descend upon you with all hardship,
and days would be so hard on you that you would feel them prolonged because of hardship till Allāh would give victory to those remaining virtuous among you.
